au.csiro.JamesGunning.waveletextraction
Class ExtractionViewer

java.lang.Object
  java.awt.Component
      java.awt.Canvas
          au.csiro.JamesGunning.waveletextraction.ExtractionViewer
All Implemented Interfaces:
java.awt.event.ActionListener, java.awt.event.ComponentListener, java.awt.event.MouseListener, java.awt.event.MouseMotionListener, java.awt.image.ImageObserver, java.awt.MenuContainer, java.awt.print.Printable, java.io.Serializable, java.util.EventListener, javax.accessibility.Accessible
public class ExtractionViewer
extends java.awt.Canvas
implements java.awt.event.MouseListener, java.awt.event.MouseMotionListener, java.awt.event.ComponentListener, java.awt.event.ActionListener, java.awt.print.Printable

A very simple viewing class to show extracted wavelets with log data and seismic on similar scales. Features Zoomable enlargements. designed to be used standalone with MLgraphing files produced by the WaveletExtractor.

Typical usage:
(1) Extract wavelet

java au.csiro.JamesGunning.waveletextraction.WaveletExtractor extractionfile.xml ... --dump-ML-parameters

(2) View the maximum likelihood tie

java au.csiro.JamesGunning.waveletextraction.ExtractionViewer MLgraphing-file.MOST_LIKELY.well-file-name.txt

Version:
1.0, 30/1/2004
Author:
James.Gunning@csiro.au
